leads.name: An Beauty Studio
leads.reason: The Prague salon offers manicures, pedicures, haircuts and eyebrow styling, while its public directory profile directs visitors to Instagram rather than a dedicated site. A service and booking website could help visitors compare treatments and enquire.
leads.score_reason: Documented 2025 business registration, Prague salon address, public phone/email and active salon listings. Independent domain search, booking UX audit, budget and decision-maker permission are not yet verified.
buying_signals: Instagram shown as website in business directory
verification_gaps: Confirm no separate independent website or booking destination exists
Confirm salon is actively taking new clients and contact reaches decision-maker
leads.offer: Booking-first beauty website with clear service menu, prices, gallery and mobile enquiry
leads.outreach_angle: Show a compact mobile service-and-booking demo based on public business facts; verify the current booking process first.

leads.name: Café Marathon
leads.reason: A café with a business registered in September 2025, listed operating hours and reviews from 2026. Its current directory listing points to Instagram instead of a standalone website; a menu/location and events page is a testable sales angle.
leads.score_reason: 2025 registration, Prague trading address, current listing and social contact are publicly documented. No independent domain search or full audit; buyer and budget are unconfirmed.
buying_signals: Instagram supplied as public web destination
verification_gaps: Find verified direct business email or phone, or confirm Instagram accepts enquiries
Check independent website and any existing menu/booking tools
Validate opening date and decision-maker interest
leads.offer: Editorial café website with menu, hours, maps, events and mobile-first directions
leads.outreach_angle: Offer a visual mobile prototype for menus, opening hours and visits; avoid claiming no website without checking.

leads.name: Polibek kafe art bar
leads.reason: A Prague specialty-coffee and art venue publishes regular social posts and has a public business email and phone. Its directory lists Facebook instead of a standalone business website, suggesting a potential event calendar and discoverability pitch.
leads.score_reason: Public Prague operating listing, email, phone and 2026 social updates support a real business. Opening/registration date and absence of a standalone website remain unverified, so this is a provisional choice.
buying_signals: Specialty coffee, local beer and emerging-art concept
verification_gaps: Confirm opening/registration date is within 24 months or document an exception
Confirm whether any independent site already exists
Verify whether events/portfolio and booking features would add value
leads.offer: Art-forward café microsite with rotating exhibition calendar, menu and booking/contact CTAs
leads.outreach_angle: Pitch an exhibition/event calendar and location-first mobile experience, after confirming no existing site covers that need.
